budgets.static_derivation: T<=6000 actual side computes,S<=5 starts: copy<=2T+4S;forward<=256T+64S;jacBody<=192T+48S;jac<=4T;fullM<=T;objectVelocity<=2T+S. New source must demonstrate these before GO; no undeclared out-of-compute IK/plan calls.

command.cancel: At next control after first actually consumed nonzero horizontal foot reference velocity, request cancel; same smooth body stop and complete/reload airborne pair, no future pair.
command.held: Worker publishes fresh command each actual control; no reset or B22 handoff at per-leg or distance boundaries.
command.input_conflict_or_expiry: Same zero-target safe-stop path with explicit reason; no stale command queue.
command.ramp: C2 quintic velocity interpolation from current commanded velocity/zero endpoint derivatives; acceleration is analytic derivative; body XY reference is exact time integral, initial base XY origin.
command.raw_B22_motion: forward/lateral/yaw raw operator and servo fields remain exactly zero in existing B22 encoder; continuous vy travels only new independent side intent channel.
command.release: At raw active_controls boundary, set target velocity zero, stop admitting a new swing pair, complete/reload any already committed pair, settle all4; return B22 only after handoff gate.
command.reverse: New opposite command must await the same all4 stop boundary. This pilot does not execute reversal and does not claim its qualification.

execution_owner: /root only; agents read sources and write new files, no execution

implementation.root: continuation35/root35: sole persistent plant/worker/host/model/native guard/archive/session, new per-control/native schema glue, no reuse of single-leg success classifier as qualification
implementation.sol32: continuation35/sol35: command/ref/phase pure core, pair-mask IK adapter and explicit dual-leg compute, pure fixtures
implementation.sol33: continuation35/read35: independent actual contact/force/task/reference/controller proof; reuse reader26.check_native/check_contact and old B22 check_controller below single-leg layer
implementation.source_reuse: Reuse immutable deep engine/plant/binding/native/model/copy/archive modules; do not copy all old experiment chains or modify C34. New semantics get explicit schema and independent checks.

native_safety.actuator_torque_limits: Exact frozen original16 actuator limits; never increased.
native_safety.force_evidence: For every native substep keep all true contact local6D wrench, frame, position, wheel/terrain assignment, active address and normal load. Independently reconstruct per-contact world force/moment, full robot contact sum force and moment about same saved after-state COM, and separate two-stance normal sum. No scratch/command force substituted for actual reaction.
native_safety.joint_limits: Exact compiled original joint ranges and same bounded IK acceptance <=.008m.

new_pair_contact_gate.all4_entry_and_stop: All four wheels actual active contacts with positive normal load.
new_pair_contact_gate.clarification: 0.5mg is the SUM of the two named stance-wheel normal loads, not a per-wheel threshold and not all-wheel sum.
new_pair_contact_gate.during_air: Every one of five native substeps must satisfy current stance-pair contact and total normal gate; no loss grace and no flight.
new_pair_contact_gate.horizontal_swing: For each swing wheel and every actual horizontal-motion native substep: complete collision-shape min Z>.012m and no active terrain contact. Start admission uses only current/previous physical evidence; after-step failure remains failure.
new_pair_contact_gate.per_current_stance_wheel: At least one true active terrain contact and independently summed positive normal_load>1e-8N.

native_safety.qualification_boundary: New two-support semantics replace old tripod margin/single-leg READY and are explicitly new. Old dynamic_margin proxy does not prove this gait stable. Full original native pose/actuator/collision/state/clock checks remain, but do not claim C34 tripod qualification.
native_safety.rolling: All original B22 rolling native/world bounds and controller reconstruction retained.

order_and_stop: Fixed listed order. Begin next case only if full online physical/task/contact/archive/effort gates of every prior case pass. First controlled quality failure ends campaign; any native/source/archive/mandatory failure ends all physics. No replacement point, parameter sweep, retry or budget reallocation.
purpose: One deterministic finite campaign asks whether explicit two-support continuous scheduling can sustain actual >=.020m/s and safely stop within unchanged native actuator/pose/collision limits. It is not RL, GUI delivery or inherited C34 three-support qualification.

reference.IK: New same-scratch pair-mask IK; reuse immutable Fast geometry/kinematics machinery but preserve two raised target Z values. Never concatenate two single-leg IK solutions or invoke old single-leg compute as dual-leg control.

body.force: m*(g + a_ref +26*(p_ref-base_position)+9*(v_ref-vCOM)); original orientation gains180/25 and angular law
body.position: entry base position + analytic commanded XY displacement, fixed entry base Z and yaw
body.reference_budget_note: Check actual reference acceleration*h/g <=.015; this is not a bound on total feedback force or real CoP.

reference.force_allocation: Original finite least-squares allocation and per-wheel .85mg normal cap/.60 tangential cap, with explicit pair support weights and unchanged final actuator clips.
reference.geometry_precondition: Verify original FL/FR/RL/RR wheel mapping and opposite-quadrant pairs from entry geometry; do not infer swapped indices.

horizontal.clock: Advance only after this measured start permission. Do not lower before horizontal reference reaches its zero-derivative endpoint.
horizontal.start_permission: Both intended swing whole-wheel minima in current measured state >.012m; both had no active terrain contact in all five previous native substeps; current stance pair passed actual contact/load gate. No future state used.

reference.inertia: Explicit6x6 submatrix for both swing-leg3DOFs from the one saved fullM cache; exact phase enable and reconstruction recorded.

landing.projection: Project raw XY displacement radially into60mm ball, record raw/projected/consumed and saturation. No discarded or hidden proposal.
landing.raw: entry nominal foot offset from entry base + current body reference + v_ref*(.60+.375)s +.08s*(vCOM-v_ref), XY only; terrain-relative nominal Z.
landing.stance: World anchors remain fixed until actual touchdown; record old/new anchors at pair completion.

reference.phase_transition: Next pair can start transfer only after both returning wheels have actual terrain contact and positive load, all4 loaded, dwell/load complete. At most named pair swings; no flight.
reference.wheel_brake: Original12 position and2 velocity wheel brake, original wheel PD replacement and unchanged actuator limits.

required_before_physics: Root meaningful pure tests only on new math/state transition/command expiry/stop/multi-leg IK mask/projection/contact-load aggregations, source before/after hashes.
No cold constructor/bootstrap model probes beyond single reserved attempt; source audit confirms installed site-packages first and actual cold saved reader module closure.
Freeze exact source worker/host/controller/reader hashes, dynamic signal interfaces, source-go and immutable request.
Source GO must explicitly review the new pair semantics and cost definition; current design document is not physical permission.

task.active_origin: Actual first side pre-state after exactly200 B22 controls.
task.cancel: No nominal target-completion speed or goal-error claim; all native/new-contact/all4-stop/retention/rollback gates required.

continuous.definition: Use entry-heading signed displacement difference over controls100..500 for mean; each velocity from actual pre/post state consistently, not reference metadata.
continuous.reference_goal: True integrated smoothed command including stopping ramp; nominal target .150m for six-second .025 pulse with complete symmetric start/stop ramps. Do not give overshoot speed credit.

cost.continuous_tau2_integral_per_commanded_m: Must not exceed accepted C33 same-direction full-scene integral/.03; report exact old/new denominators. No per-distance metric for zero/cancel.
cost.metric: actual full-scene normalized torque-square integral and mean; NOT energy
cost.semantics: This new continuous task explicitly uses an absolute pilot mean fence plus distance efficiency. It does not claim the C34 external torque-mean quality thresholds were passed; hardware torque limits are unchanged. Before RL, freeze strong same-task fixed and require no more than1.10 its mean cost.

in_place.claim: Only two-support/load/stop feasibility, never speed proof.

task.qualification: In-place, both continuous directions and both cancellation cases all must pass before claiming this fixed pilot feasible; any partial pass is reported as such. No RL or fluent GUI claim.
